summary: FORMAT EXAMPLE ONLY (fictional library app). Renewals fail for loans created before the due-date migration because dueDate is a string there and LoanService.renew calls getTime() on it.

rootCause.title: Legacy loans store dueDate as a string
rootCause.explanation: FORMAT EXAMPLE. The importer writes dueDate as an ISO string; LoanService.renew assumes a Date.

evidence.text: http.unhandled_error TypeError: loan.dueDate.getTime is not a function

ruledOut.reason: FORMAT EXAMPLE. The mailer is never reached for the failing request.

fix.summary: FORMAT EXAMPLE. Normalise dueDate when loading loans.
